lines.text: Your AI agent shouldn't live on someone else's computer.
An agent you own, that lives in your texts.
Just message it. It searches, sets reminders, and gets things done.
Pick the model behind every part. OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, xAI, or one running locally.
It all runs on your machine. Your keys. Your messages never leave it.
It can even use your computer, and asks before anything it can't undo.
And it answers only you, and the people you allow.
Set it up from one dashboard.
OpenBots. Open source. Own your agent.
